name: Default
shortDescription: HTPC and homelab services organizer that groups your web apps into tabs behind one login, with SSO, homepage widgets and an SQLite database.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying: the first visitor runs the setup wizard and creates the admin account. Keep the database location under /config (the suggested path is fine) so the SQLite database stays on the persistent volume.
The container downloads the Organizr code from GitHub on every start, so the server needs outbound internet access and a restart updates the app.
